purpose: Noise of the decision workload under unchanged production

conditions.build: release, all features of 781d064 (no trace feature existed), x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
conditions.workload: routed 4.5 ms RTT, bridged individual QinQ 1522-byte frames with completed checksums, four workers and lanes, TAP txqueuelen 500, 1452-byte outer UDP ceiling with active PMTU discovery
conditions.generator: udp_load with PR_SET_TIMERSLACK=1, SEGMENTS=1, GENERATOR_PROCESSES=4 (one CPU each for senders, receivers shared over two CPUs)
conditions.order: for each repeat: f4-l0, f16-l0, f4-l1, f16-l1; fresh daemons per invocation
conditions.cpus: daemons 0-3/4-7, senders 8-11/14-17, receivers 12-13/18-19; host load otherwise idle
conditions.isolation: no local build or test during load
conditions.analysis: examples/sweep_report.rs; goodput from receiver samples, missing includes drain, CPU over before-sent
